audience: support teams who handle customer tickets in Freshdesk

useCases.title: Find open, urgent or unassigned tickets
useCases.text: The AI searches tickets with the query DSL, for example by status, priority, agent, group or tag. You get a list of what needs attention.

useCases.title: Reply to a ticket or add an internal note
useCases.text: The AI adds a public reply that is sent to the requester, or a note that is private by default.

useCases.title: Update many tickets at once
useCases.text: The AI finds the tickets, for example all open tickets with one tag. It sets the same status, priority, group or agent on up to 100 tickets in one step and can add the same reply to each.

useCases.title: Answer from the knowledge base and canned responses
useCases.text: The AI searches your solution articles and your canned responses, then drafts a reply that uses your approved text.

useCases.title: Write or update a knowledge base article
useCases.text: The AI turns a solved ticket into a new solution article as a draft, or updates an existing article. You publish it when it is ready.

useCases.title: Log time and read satisfaction ratings
useCases.text: The AI logs time spent on a ticket and lists time entries per agent or company. It also reads the satisfaction survey results for a period.
